knowledge_gaps: The gate's block location, branch depth, normalization, channel widths and exact causal padding are unspecified. Masking only branch outputs may allow padding activations to propagate through intermediate convolutions.
Small dilation does not necessarily select recent interactions: preceding hidden states already encode older history. Gate weights alone cannot establish stale-interest suppression.
Uniform gates isolate adaptive weighting, but a corrected-baseline comparison and parameter-matched control are also needed to distinguish gating benefits from increased capacity.

No baseline validation HR@10, experiment runtime estimate, budget allocation or checkpoint-selection schedule is supplied. Repeated selection on the same 800 validation users risks validation overfitting.

Mean cosine similarity near zero does not establish broadly dispersed embeddings or rule out low-rank collapse. Raw logit margins also depend on embedding norms and are not directly comparable across category models.
Originality and potential scores are subjective; implementation difficulty may be understated because causality, intermediate masking and predictor parity require verification.
